methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-15. Relevance AI's live pricing page (relevanceai.com/pricing) renders ONLY the Enterprise tier; the Free tier and overage rates are confirmed on the official docs (relevanceai.com/docs/admin/subscriptions/new-pricing, relevanceai.com/docs/get-started/subscriptions/plans), but the numeric monthly prices for Pro and Team are NOT published on any official Relevance page. Two third-party sources conflict on Team's price (costbench.com cites $234/mo billed annually; lindy.ai/blog cites $349/mo), so per a null-beats-a-guess policy Pro and Team monthlyUsd are set to null with the third-party figures noted. Lindy (lindy.ai/pricing + lindy.ai/security): Plus/Pro/Max confirmed at $49.99/$99.99/$199.99, no forever-free tier (7-day trial only), SOC2 Type II + HIPAA + GDPR + PIPEDA stated; BAA not explicitly stated on the security page so baa set to null. CrewAI (crewai.com/pricing + trust.crewai.com): only Free Basic ($0) and quote-only Enterprise; FedRAMP High and 'SAM certified' claims were not supported by any source and were removed; SOC2 Type I (Nov 2025), HIPAA audit (Feb 2026), GDPR confirmed. Stack AI (stackai.com/pricing): only Free ($0) and Enterprise; the mid-2025 Starter ($199) and Team ($899) tiers are absent from the live page and unconfirmed, so they are excluded; SOC2 Type II + HIPAA + GDPR + ISO 27001 confirmed on the homepage and blog. Gumloop (gumloop.com/pricing): Free ($0, 5k credits), Pro ($37/mo), Enterprise; SOC2 + GDPR retained but HIPAA could not be independently confirmed, so hipaa set to null. Beam AI (beam.ai/pricing-2): Core $0, Grow $499+, Scale $1,990+, Managed Services $9,990+ confirmed; ISO 27001 + SOC2 Type II + GDPR on homepage, no HIPAA. Vellum (vellum.ai/pricing): Free + Pro at $50/mo headline ($10 platform + $35 Medium compute + $5 storage) confirmed; compliance not stated, all null. Lyzr (docs.lyzr.ai/introduction/plans + lyzr.ai/pricing + security.lyzr.ai): Community $0, Starter $19, Pro $99 ($79/mo annual), Enterprise; per-run $0.08 cloud / $0.03 VPC; SOC2 Type II + ISO 27001:2022 + HIPAA + ISO 42001:2023 + GDPR confirmed. Cognosys, MultiOn, and Wordware excluded as no longer standalone/self-serve. All quote-only/enterprise plans carry null monthlyUsd. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Relevance AI
vendors.provenance: Live pricing page (relevanceai.com/pricing) renders only the Enterprise tier. Free tier limits and overage rates confirmed on official docs (relevanceai.com/docs/admin/subscriptions/new-pricing, confirming the Sep 8 2025 dual-meter overhaul into Actions + Vendor Credits and the sunset of the Business plan). Numeric Pro/Team monthly prices are not published on any official page; third-party sources conflict (costbench.com $234 vs lindy.ai/blog $349 for Team), so Pro and Team monthlyUsd are set to null. SOC2 Type II and GDPR per trust.relevanceai.com (referenced by official docs).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 200 actions/month, one-time 1,000 vendor credits bonus, 1 build user, 1 project, marketplace access. Permanent free tier (not a time-limited trial). Confirmed on official docs.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Self-serve tier exists per official docs but no price is published on any official Relevance page. Third-party (costbench.com) cites $19/mo billed annually with 2,500 actions/month (30,000/year), $240 vendor credits/year, 2 build users. Actions top-up: $80/1,000; vendor credits top-up: $20/10,000 (overage rates confirmed on official docs). monthlyUsd nulled because not officially published.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Self-serve tier exists per official docs but no price is published on any official Relevance page. Third-party sources conflict on price (costbench.com $234/mo billed annually; lindy.ai/blog $349/mo); both cite 7,000 actions/month, $840 vendor credits/year, 5 build users + 45 end users. monthlyUsd nulled because not officially published and third-party figures disagree.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom volume, unlimited agents and tools, unlimited workforces, SSO/RBAC/audit logs, calling and meeting agents, dedicated account manager, custom vendor credits. Contact sales. Only tier shown on the live pricing page.
